input.summary: parts/shell.mjs builds the sidewalk, deepslate ground storey, floors, stair housing, partitions, jettied half-timber storey, gable frames and wing walls. 1063 cells placed with no refused writes and no off-palette blocks. The build is unfinished: make.sh stops because roof.json (written by the Roofs part) is missing, so no whole build.nbt exists yet.
left: make.sh exits before writing build.nbt because roof.json is missing; the Roofs part must write it. build.next.nbt (shell only, 1735 cells) rendered and passed mcd check.
mcd walk and mcd light were not run; they need the openings filled and the roof in.
mcd check reports 4 orphan collar-beam ends at (8,14,8), (14,14,8), (8,14,22), (14,14,22). The roof should support them.
Wing gable wool at z=13 covers x=18..20 at y=6..7, which may collide with the roof tool's slope cells; the Roofs part should check.
Left unset on purpose: all openings, the Mann brace cells, the shop breast cells (7..9,2,9) and (13..15,2,9), and the oven mouth. Yard patches are for the yard part.
Stairs, floors and partitions were not walk-tested.

waste.what: Worked out by hand which cells collide between stairHousing, the y=6 stair hole, the y=1 floor and the partition posts and rails. I also split the opening and brace cells into per-wall lists.
waste.cost: about 10 minutes of cell-by-cell reasoning, plus an unused braceCells helper
waste.tool: A runParts mode that skips already-owned cells for a part's own writes (or a `g.setIfFree` helper), so floors and partitions can be filled over stair cells without a manual `free` check. A `fillFree(g, a, b, block, skip)` helper in the build library would also replace my local one.

waste.what: Wrote local helpers fillFree, wood and log, and a wing wall loop with an opening predicate
waste.tool: A vocab `solidWall(g, axis, fixed, a0, a1, y0, y1, block, openings)` for non-brick walls (masonryWall hard-codes deepslate_bricks), plus partition(g, ...) and floor(g, ...) helpers

waste.what: The vocab.mjs import path for B was wrong. B comes from the build library, not vocab.mjs.
waste.tool: Re-export B from vocab.mjs, or say where it comes from in the part-module stub comment

waste.what: make.sh cannot produce build.nbt until the Roofs part writes roof.json, so my part has no whole build.nbt of its own to verify.
waste.cost: the final make.sh step was skipped and I checked build.next.nbt instead
waste.tool: make.sh should skip the roof step with a warning when roof.json is absent, so stopping at any point still leaves a whole build.nbt
